d: We are seeking a skilled and creative Content Creator specializing in videos, reels, and photography to join our team. Proficiency in shooting, editing, and post-production software for videos and photographs.
Strong knowledge of social media platforms, trends, and best practices.
Excellent creative and storytelling skills, with a keen eye for detail and aesthetics.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, collaborating effectively with cross-functional team members.
Strong time-management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present ideas and concepts effectively.
Flexibility to work outside regular office hours when required to meet project deadlines or attend events.

A portfolio showcasing previous work and creative abilities.

d: Job Category Rooms & Guest Services Operations
Location Building No. 153 Street No. 347, P.O. Box 4010, Lusail, QatarVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

d: Reports to: Manager - Talent Acquisition & Employee Relations

American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs in Engineering and Computing, Architecture and Design, Business, Arts and Sciences, and Education. The programs are delivered in English and follow the American model of higher education. AIU serves a community of more than 4,000 students and is implementing the RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five-year institutional transformation strategy anchored in research development, international accreditation, student success, employability, and community engagement.

HR Business Advisors will serve as a direct point of contact for employees of their appointed departments, ensuring effective communication and collaboration between departments and the HR department. The primary responsibility will be to understand the dynamics of assigned departments and provide support throughout various HR processes.
q: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field; HR certification preferred.
Experience: 6 years in HR, ideally in higher education or a similar setting.
Strong grasp of HR practices, employment laws, recruitment, onboarding, and employee relations. Proficient with HRIS/ATS (e.g., BambooHR) and Microsoft Office.
Communication & Interpersonal: Excellent written/verbal skills with ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally. Strong relationship-building and problem-solving skills.
Organizational & Adaptability: Skilled in managing multiple priorities, ensuring compliance, and working effectively in a multicultural environment.
Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on our website and submit a resume and cover letter via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The successful candidate is expected to commence employment immediately.

d: Company Description Local is a technology platform transforming how on-site businesses across the GCC handle payments and commerce. The platform enables customers to pay in seconds using QR-led flows that connect directly to merchants’ systems, helping restaurants, cafés, hotels, and hospitals reduce friction and increase throughput. Local operates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Bahrain, partnering with POS providers, regional enterprises, and service businesses to deliver reliable, scalable payment infrastructure tailored to local regulations and market behaviors. Backed by 500 Global Sanabil, Local focuses on building robust infrastructure grounded in customer behavior, operational efficiency, and enterprise readiness. The team is dedicated to making payments seamless and enabling smarter service commerce in fast-paced, high-volume environments.

Role Description The Sales Manager will lead the growth of Local’s payment and commerce solutions in the Capital Governorate, Bahrain, focusing on on-site businesses such as restaurants, cafés, hotels, and hospitals. This full-time, on-site role includes identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, managing the sales pipeline, and driving end-to-end sales cycles from prospecting through negotiation and closing. The Sales Manager will build and maintain strong relationships with merchants, POS partners, and enterprise customers, providing consultative guidance on how Local’s platform can improve operational efficiency and revenue. Daily responsibilities include conducting client meetings and demos, collaborating with product and operations teams to ensure successful onboarding, tracking performance against targets, and reporting on market trends and customer feedback. The role also involves representing Local at industry events, supporting account growth and retention, and contributing to sales processes and playbooks.
q: Demonstrated experience in B2B sales or account management, preferably in SaaS, fintech, payments, or POS-related solutions.
Strong skills in prospecting, pipeline management, consultative selling, and negotiation, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Ability to build and sustain long-term client relationships, manage stakeholder expectations, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Solid understanding of on-site commerce environments (e.g., F&B, hospitality, healthcare) and comfort discussing operational workflows and ROI with business leaders.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the use of CRM tools and data to inform sales strategies and decisions.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with adaptability to evolving products, processes, and market dynamics.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Previous experience in the GCC region and familiarity with local business practices and regulatory landscapes is highly beneficial.
